what: Tapping the 50px round button (three thin lines) floating at the bottom right of the screen bends the lines into an X (.3s), and a panel attached to the bottom-right corner (only the top-left corner rounded 30px) slides in 100px from the right as it turns on (.6s expo.out). Behind it a 30px blur veil spreads over the same duration. Button · veil · Esc · links inside the panel all close it the same way — a thumb-zone menu for phone screens where the header menu collapses

options.x: Distance the panel slides in (px), default 100
options.ease: Curve (four cubic-bezier numbers or a GSAP name), default 0.16,1,0.3,1 (expo.out)
options.--fx-gap: Distance between button and screen edge (via style), default 20px
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Round button — empty inside <span> One (draw three lines)

use: Menu 1…
note: On wide screens the using side hides the wrapping element with display: none (the original is visible only below 992px). Panels · curtains start as visibility: hidden so they don’t show through before they attach
